name: venue-till
gateway_reason: The Till's sent-receipt page and the scan-to-pay page (/pay/till/<code>: view, pay, confirm on return) are used without a Mingla account (O1 receipts, O2); the pay-code actions are rate-limited per IP and per code and answer one 404 for any unknown code. Every staff action verifies the bearer in code and passes the verified user to service-only Till RPCs that check venue.sell, money rights or brand rank.
